newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields same ,6-,9-,12- mo fall.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields same ,6-,9-,12- mo fall.

text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills were unchanged and six-, nine-, and 12-month yields dipped from the last sale on February 13, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills remained at 28.99 percent, six-month bills fell to 35.67 percent from 37.21 percent, nine-month bills eased to 39.08 percent from 39.37 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 40.86 percent from 40.90 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15 million hryvnia 17 million hryvnia
Amount sold 7.86 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.33 million UAH 15.85 million UAH
The central bank sold 78,639 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is February 20.
The results of Tuesday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17 million hryvnia no limit
Amount sold 16.24 million UAH 7.58 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.79 million UAH 6.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 162,407 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is February 20.
The results of Tuesday's auction of nine-month discount T-bills were as follows:
Issue volume 25 million hryvnia no limit
Amount sold 25 million UAH 43.78 million UAH
Actual amount raised 19.34 million UAH 33.82 million UAH
The central bank sold 250,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is February 20.
The results of Tuesday's 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35 million hryvnia no limit
Amount sold 35 million UAH 36.40 million UAH
Actual amount raised 24.87 million UAH 25.86 million UAH
The central bank sold 350,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is February 20.
